string.text: Exchange for a code to the lab

The leader of one of the bandit groups in the Dark Valley has agreed to give the password to enter the lab. In exchange for this information, he wants an AS "Val" rifle, and five bottles of vodka. If I can't get him five bottles of vodka, five jars will do. He also asked me to say hello to Snitch at the Bar.
Return to the leader of the group "Evil Dead"
